ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher; note the driver-side conflict between timeline/system records and the driver's "I'm Here" claim for account review.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver statement asserting he pressed 'I'm Here' and waited >3 min conflicts with the timeline record F7 (driver_pressed_here_at is null); system records override statements, so the claim cannot support NS-1(i).

Cumulative 4 min 30 s within 200 m is measured from first entry at 09:54:55 (F5), not from any arrival/tap of record, so it does not by itself establish the >3 min waiting requirement keyed to an arrival event (F3 shows 3 min 25 s stationary; F6 shows 3 min 5 s after the claimed tap).

Driver profile shows 2 upheld no-show disputes, but profile facts cannot alone decide this case, and the NS-2 account-flag trigger (tapped 'I'm Here' while GPS outside pickup radius) is not met — GPS placed him within 200 m [F1][F3].
